description: Email the triage outcome back to the broker over the Gmail connection's confirm surface, then record the outbound reply on the submission. Requires a saved risk finding. Fired only from the operator-confirmed Send reply action via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools, so the model cannot call it.

submission_id.description: The submission whose outcome to send, e.g. sub_bistro_ember.

message.description: Optional operator note prepended to the reply body.
